name: feature
description: Change: adds something new (bumps the patch number)

name: bugfix
description: Change: fixes something that was broken (adds a letter to the version)

name: documentation
description: Change: only the docs, README or AGENTS.md

name: maintenance
description: Change: refactor, cleanup or tooling, nothing the user sees

name: ui
description: Area: the page in the browser

name: hub
description: Area: hub mode, collecting from other devices and routers

name: tracking
description: Area: what is measured, the metrics and the add-ons

name: storage
description: Area: the database, history and retention

name: server
description: Area: the backend's API, settings and access rules

name: install
description: Area: the Docker image, the Linux install, the Windows installer and updates

name: repo
description: Area: CI, workflows, repo checks and project docs
